# MilePost Zero: Ineke - Imported Goods Merchant

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Sep 18, 2024
- 2 min read

Updated: Oct 16, 2024

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_32fd1b16b06844e69207cd8f9210b971~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit: __SugarBombsRADS__

__Name__

Ineke

__Role__

Imported Goods Merchant

__Location__

After being hired: From Marley's desk, face north and walk straight ahead. Stop at the stairs on your right, go up the stairs, and turn left. Follow the hallway down to the grey metal door. Open the door and walk forward a few steps. Ineke's room will be on your right, next to the antiques sign on the wall.

__Cost__

Hire Cost (Tier 1) - 150 Supplies

Upgrade 1 (Tier 2) - 250 Supplies

Upgrade 2 (Tier 3) - 500 Supplies

__Notes__

To unlock the vendor's inventory items, plans, and next-tier level, you must go through all their dialogue options. This needs to be done before each upgrade to the next tier. If the option to upgrade doesn’t appear in Marley’s dialogue and you have enough supplies, it means you missed part of the conversation. Go back and talk to the vendor again to complete any missed dialogue, and the upgrade option should then become available.

Yes
